texts.setting.starttime.about: The date and time the game reads when it starts, in seconds since 1970 (Unix time), in UTC; it then runs with the frames. The default is the first of January 2000. OpenBOR's own random numbers do not depend on it, but a game's scripts can read the date. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.pack.help: The game's .pak file (OpenBOR games are their data folder packed into one .pak).
texts.slot.savedata.help: OpenBOR's own save files for this game, as Export Save Data writes them: <game>.cfg (the settings, the keys among them), <game>.sav (the progress), <game>.hi (the high scores), <game>.scr (what the game's scripts keep). Their names must be the game's: test.pak's settings are test.cfg. The game starts with them.
